page.framework: server-rendered HTML with jQuery and third-party ad SDKs
page.notes: Public adult-video directory. Root redirects to /xxxx/. Intermittent 503 responses were directly captured.

artifacts.caption: Homepage metadata, semantics, links and CSS probe
Mobile sizing, focus and resource attributes
Detail metadata, video, overlays and forms
Arabic lang/dir and logical CSS probe

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot or computed background under an emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark condition will reveal whether surfaces re-tint; the page CSS / a color-scheme declaration is corroborating evidence. The model chooses the method.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The preferences probe reports color-scheme: normal and only an ad-injected dark media rule; the first-party palette is fixed rather than driven by the system preference.

checkOutcomes.method: a transition video, or an in-page probe of getAnimations()/computed animation under an emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce condition, can show whether motion stops. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, a 5.5-second animation remained running and several autoplay ad videos were observed.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot under emulated prefers-contrast: more / forced-colors, or an axe/contrast probe, can show whether controls and text survive. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The high-contrast probe found no first-party prefers-contrast/forced-colors rules, while all controls globally suppress outlines.

checkOutcomes.method: a transition video of a route/state change shows whether it animates; the page source / ::view-transition usage corroborates. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Route changes use ordinary document navigation with no view-transition CSS or same-document transition rules.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No first-party scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface exists; the only observed animation was an injected advertisement.
checkOutcomes.reason: No first-party scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface exists; the only observed animation was an injected advertisement.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No gesture-driven control, swipe action, carousel, or pull interaction exists on the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No gesture-driven control, swipe action, carousel, or pull interaction exists on the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: a transition video of scrolling, or CSS inspection for scroll-state container queries. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The header is fixed but has no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or state change as the long listing scrolls.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS inspection for anchor-name / position-anchor / position-try on overlays; a screenshot of an open overlay near a viewport edge can show drift. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dropdowns and the mobile side menu are custom absolutely/fixed-positioned divs; no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try rules were found.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS inspection for ::highlight / scroll-marker; a transition video can show whether attention is cued after navigation. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Listing-to-category and category-to-detail navigation provides no directional transition or post-navigation attention cue.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot on load, or a DOM probe for full-viewport overlays present before interaction. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show chat/ad notifications overlaying thumbnails, plus a large ad CTA before the first-party content.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/source inspection for popover / <dialog> / <details> vs custom overlay divs with manual dismiss handling. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM inspection found zero dialog, popover, or details elements despite custom dropdown, aside, notification, and overlay UI.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot plus layout metrics can show the proportion of the viewport given to chrome vs content. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first viewport and detail page devote prominent space to multiple ads, notifications, and chat chrome before/over the requested media.

checkOutcomes.method: layout metrics (scrollWidth vs innerWidth) and a screenshot at an emulated narrow mobile viewport reveal overflow. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360px, inner/client/scroll widths are all 360 and the mobile screenshot shows a two-column layout with no horizontal clipping.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS inspection for @container / container-type; a computed-style probe of the same component in a wide vs narrow container shows whether it adapts. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CSS has no container queries; all grid changes are controlled only by viewport media queries.

checkOutcomes.method: a focus probe (focus an element, read the computed outline) or an axe target-size check; a screenshot of a focused control corroborates. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The focus probe shows outline-style none on links, inputs, and buttons; numerous links are only 14-22px tall and Lighthouse failed target-size.

checkOutcomes.method: screenshot the first viewport and key scrolled states; inspect heading structure, nav labels, button text, and visual hierarchy; a task walkthrough can show whether the next action is obvious. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: On both listing and detail first viewports, advertising CTAs compete with or precede the site heading/player, obscuring the primary browse/watch action.

checkOutcomes.method: run the flow manually with screenshots/DOM snapshots at each step; compare expected vs actual path length; inspect form requirements, navigation continuity, and blockers. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Browse-to-category-to-video is possible, but intermittent bare 503 pages and advertising overlays/autoplay media interrupt representative steps.

checkOutcomes.method: exercise network delay/failure, invalid input, empty data and success states; screenshot the state messaging and recovery controls; inspect whether browser history and focus remain sensible. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A captured category request returned a bare nginx 503 with no retry/navigation; an unknown route returned the homepage with HTTP 200 rather than a useful 404.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse reports LCP/CLS/TBT directly and the model may run it; layout metrics + a layout-shift observer + a long-task observer (the evidence primitives) give the same signal first-party. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 10.28s and CLS 0.334, outside good thresholds; performance score was 0.55.

checkOutcomes.method: the layout primitive's CLS observer captures shifts; a transition video of the first seconds shows content jumping. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.334, consistent with late ad/notification insertion; the shorter layout capture did not reproduce the shift.

checkOutcomes.method: the layout primitive records long tasks; a heap summary shows the object population; Lighthouse reports TBT. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace found one 55ms task and only 5.16ms TBT; Lighthouse TBT was 37ms, indicating a responsive main thread during load.

checkOutcomes.method: a HAR summary can reveal cache headers, redirects, render-blocking candidates, weight offenders and dependency shape; a trace/Lighthouse insight report can corroborate LCP discovery, render-blocking, font-display and document latency. The m
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR recorded 128 requests and 1.24MB in the capture, including parser-inserted classic scripts; Lighthouse saw 5.45MB total transfer.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse/trace/code-coverage style evidence can flag unused JS/CSS, duplicated JavaScript and legacy code; a HAR summary shows third-party byte cost and request count. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 219KB unused JavaScript; the DOM shows two old jQuery versions plus many ad SDKs.

checkOutcomes.method: axe-core (injectable via the evaluate primitive) or Lighthouse's a11y audits enumerate these; a DOM probe of the accessibility-relevant attributes is a first-party alternative. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed link-name for 13 examples and frame-title; DOM contains empty-text icon/ad links and an untitled iframe.

checkOutcomes.method: axe contrast rules, a Lighthouse contrast audit, or an in-page probe computing contrast ratios from computed colours. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit passed and screenshots show high-contrast light text against dark surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: axe/Lighthouse structural audits; a focus-walk probe (tab through, read activeElement + computed outline) is a first-party alternative. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heading/landmark order passes, but the focus probe found outline-style none for every sampled interactive control.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot of body and heading text, plus CSS inspection for text-wrap / text alignment / font fallback handling. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative screenshots show readable, unclipped headings and labels at desktop and 360px.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse/axe target-size, meta-viewport and media-caption audits are useful signals; screenshots at narrow and zoomed conditions plus DOM/media inspection can corroborate. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size and the detail probe found the core video with zero caption tracks; many link targets are 14-22px tall.

checkOutcomes.method: capture Runtime/Log CDP events, or a probe that reads collected errors; Lighthouse reports this too. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports browser errors logged to the console.

checkOutcomes.method: a DOM/source probe for doctype/charset/img dimensions; CSS inspection for repetition; Lighthouse best-practices audits cover the rest. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and charset pass, but Lighthouse failed responsive image sizing and reports low-resolution images.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices audits and DevTools inspector/deprecation signals can surface these; DOM/source probes can verify paste handlers and prompt timing. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports DevTools inspector issues and BFCache prevention from a popup blocker; the page also loads jQuery 1.11.0 and 1.11.3.

checkOutcomes.method: a DOM probe reads <title> and meta[name=description]; Lighthouse SEO audits cover the same ground. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage and detail probes expose distinct descriptive titles and meta descriptions.

checkOutcomes.method: a DOM probe for anchor hrefs, viewport meta, and robots; Lighthouse SEO audits corroborate. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse SEO is 1.0, crawlable anchors and robots pass, viewport meta exists, and raw HTML contains real href links.

checkOutcomes.method: inspect response status and headers, <link rel=canonical>, hreflang links, robots meta, robots.txt and sitemap.xml; Lighthouse SEO audits cover several of these. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: robots.txt is valid, but /sitemap.xml serves HTML and arbitrary unknown paths return the homepage with HTTP 200, creating soft-404/indexing ambiguity.

checkOutcomes.method: inspect JSON-LD/microdata and social preview tags against visible content; Lighthouse has a manual structured-data audit, and ad-hoc probes can parse schema.org blocks. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: JSON-LD accurately describes the site and detail video, but neither representative page exposes Open Graph share-preview metadata.

checkOutcomes.method: inspect response headers / page protocol via an evaluate probe or the network layer; Lighthouse best-practices flags HTTPS and CSP issues. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, and frame protection are absent; all 13 observed cookies lack Secure and most use SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: inspect network requests and third-party origins; a probe of analytics/beacon calls. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR attributed 90/128 requests and 1.16MB/1.24MB to third-party origins, dominated by advertising/push SDKs; persistent tracking-like cookies last 400 days.

checkOutcomes.method: a probe for permission requests fired on load; source inspection for passkey / WebAuthn / navigator.credentials usage in auth flows. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No geolocation/notification prompt occurred on load and no first-party authentication surface is present.

checkOutcomes.method: inspect response headers and browser security state; Lighthouse/DevTools security audits can corroborate HSTS, clickjacking, Trusted Types, origin isolation and third-party cookie findings. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No CSP/frame-ancestors, HSTS, nosniff, Permissions-Policy, or clickjacking header is present; Referrer-Policy is unsafe-url.

checkOutcomes.method: load with scripting disabled or compare a no-JS fetch of the HTML against the rendered page; check for Baseline-aware fallbacks in source. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Discoverability reports 98% raw/rendered content coverage, no JS shell, and title/H1/description available without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: exercise menus near viewport edges with a screenshot; a probe of async/visibility behaviour. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Repeated route captures intermittently produced a bare 503, and custom ad/dropdown overlays do not use resilient top-layer or anchor-positioned primitives.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: This is a server-rendered media directory, not an app-like installable experience; offline playback is not a proportionate expectation.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a server-rendered media directory, not an app-like installable experience; offline playback is not a proportionate expectation.

checkOutcomes.method: simulate failed fetches/offline mode or inspect representative 404/500 routes; screenshots and DOM snapshots of error/loading/empty states show whether recovery is possible. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A live category request showed only nginx 503 with no recovery controls; missing routes silently render the homepage at HTTP 200.

checkOutcomes.method: a DOM probe for <html lang>/dir and CSS inspection for logical vs physical properties. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Arabic route sets lang=ar but no dir; CSS inspection counted 84 physical left/right rules and zero logical-property rules.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No locale-sensitive dates, numbers, currencies, or durations are rendered in the audited UI.
checkOutcomes.reason: No locale-sensitive dates, numbers, currencies, or durations are rendered in the audited UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No user-facing event times, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive data are present.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user-facing event times, recurring intervals, or time-zone-sensitive data are present.

checkOutcomes.method: a screenshot of consent/upsell/cancel flows; source inspection for declarative button actions vs misleading controls. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshots show disguised/native ad tiles, a dominant chat CTA, and unsolicited notification overlays competing with content; many outbound links open via a global base target.

checkOutcomes.method: exercise a form, submit invalid input, and observe timing and clarity of errors via a screenshot or a :user-invalid / aria-invalid probe. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The DMCA form inputs are not required and expose no authored validation semantics; failure recovery is not visible before submission.

checkOutcomes.method: source/DOM inspection for autocomplete attributes on form fields; a probe of autofill affordances. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search, name, and email fields expose empty autocomplete values, so search/contact input receives no useful autofill assistance.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No first-party checkout, subscription, authentication, or account-management flow was present; outbound advertising is judged under dark patterns/privacy instead.
checkOutcomes.reason: No first-party checkout, subscription, authentication, or account-management flow was present; outbound advertising is judged under dark patterns/privacy instead.

checkOutcomes.method: inspect transferred image bytes vs displayed size; source inspection for modern formats and resolution handling. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse transferred 5.45MB and failed responsive image sizing/low-resolution delivery; the media directory serves hundreds of thumbnails without modern responsive evidence.

checkOutcomes.method: a long-task / network probe for background fetches and processing while idle or backgrounded. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page starts multiple ad/push SDKs and autoplay media; HAR recorded 22 scripts and 16 fetches while Lighthouse found 219KB unused JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: a HAR summary shows third-party bytes, font/media weight and caching; screenshots/video reveal autoplay and decorative media; trace/layout evidence shows whether media/animation keeps work running. The model chooses.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 90 requests and 1.16MB in HAR, while category/detail probes show multiple autoplay ad videos unrelated to the requested content.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site exposes public media listings but declares no agent-facing intent; WebMCP is emerging and absence is treated as an opportunity, not a failure.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site exposes public media listings but declares no agent-facing intent; WebMCP is emerging and absence is treated as an opportunity, not a failure.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and DOM/content applicability review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model task is part of the core video-browsing experience, so on-device inference is not applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model task is part of the core video-browsing experience, so on-device inference is not applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: compare heap snapshots for retained growth - a baseline, then one taken after repeating the interaction with `--interact` about 10x (the memory-tracer methodology: baseline -> repeat -> post -> compare). Performance.getMetrics (JSHeapUsedSi
checkOutcomes.evidence: Comparable full-load snapshots changed from 238,513 to 239,842 nodes and 16.40MB to 16.46MB after ten menu toggles, about 0.3% size growth, with no unbounded trend signal.

checkOutcomes.method: a single `heap` summary's totals (nodeCount, totalSelfSizeBytes, constructor population) plus Performance.getMetrics (Nodes, JSHeapUsedSize) give the current footprint to judge against the page's purpose. Chrome DevTools MCP heap snapshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: A stable full-load heap snapshot contains about 239k V8 nodes and 16.4MB self size, a heavy footprint for a simple server-rendered listing and consistent with many ad SDKs.

checkOutcomes.method: the `heap` summary by constructor (Detached* nodes) compared across a before/after pair shows a growing detached-DOM population; an `evaluate` probe can sample listener/timer counts (e.g. getEventListeners-style counting, or instrumenting a
checkOutcomes.evidence: Detached constructors do not appear among top constructors and the repeated-toggle pair grew only about 0.3%; no accumulation signal was observed.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this site’s declared or observed surfaces.

paths.description: Homepage/category index, representing global chrome, discovery, ads, search and category entry points.
Dancing category listing, representing paginated category templates and links to details.
Representative video detail and watch journey.

Unknown path and intermittently failing category requests, representing error recovery.
